concerns.text: Task T000 is correctly placed first, but it is the only foundational task. All subsequent tasks depend on its outputs, so the `[P]` (parallel‑safe) tag on T000 is acceptable only if no other task runs concurrently with it. Ensure the pipeline enforces T000’s exclusive execution before any other `[P]` tasks.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Data acquisition, parsing, and Intent‑Graph construction
concerns.text: Tasks T001‑T005 are marked `[P]` yet they have strict producer‑consumer relationships (e.g., T002 reads files produced by T001, T003 reads output of T002, T004 reads output of T003, T005 reads output of T004). The `[P]` tag incorrectly suggests they can run in parallel; this violates the ordering requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Agent execution, evaluation, and statistical validation
concerns.text: Task T006 is also tagged `[P]` but depends on the Intent Graphs generated by T004. It cannot be safely parallelised with T004 or any earlier task that writes to `data/derived/intent_graphs/`. The `[P]` tag should be removed or the dependency made explicit.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Agent execution, evaluation, and statistical validation
concerns.text: Task T007 and T008 are read‑only on `data/raw/` and can remain `[P]`; however, they must not start before T001 completes. The current ordering respects this, but the `[P]` tag should be limited to indicate they are safe to run concurrently **only after** T001 has succeeded.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Agent execution, evaluation, and statistical validation
concerns.text: Task T009 aggregates results from T006‑T008 (and optionally T004b). It is correctly placed after all producers, but its `[P]` tag is misleading because it must wait for all prior logs to be fully written.
Task T013 depends on the outputs of T009‑T012; therefore it cannot be parallel‑safe. The `[P]` tag should be removed.
Task T014 generates checksums for *all* data artifacts and must run after every other task. Its `[P]` tag is inappropriate.
